entries.computational_distinction: None established; exact stop shadows match eight actual stopped outputs.
entries.cpu_cost: Batch timings retained; Windows resolution causes some zero measurements; actual request latency is not isolated.
entries.fair_comparison: Same sixteen raw outputs; answer-loss and false-turn transitions; native/template alternatives need separately authorized inference.
entries.falsification: If standard methods achieve independent boundary targets, reject the claimed new-parser need.
entries.independent_test: Prospective human-adjudicated boundaries including quotes, headings, code fences and no-answer states.
entries.observed_failure: All sixteen first replies are promises; actual stops suppress continuation without delivering requested components.
entries.persona_cost: Cuts may remove useful style or quoted content; two authored fenced-role fixtures show premature cuts.
entries.proposed_algorithm: No new parser; retain five existing extractors and actual-stop/offline-shadow comparisons.
entries.published_solution: Native EOG, conventional stops, role/fence parsing, official templates; generation-time grammar methods are distinct.
entries.remaining_gap: Independent boundary truth and model/task adequacy, not a demonstrated need for another parser.

entries.computational_distinction: None demonstrated beyond established structured verification.
entries.cpu_cost: Current objective checks are offline; future model-call and retrieval costs must be fully charged.
entries.fair_comparison: Exact component matching, existing metric contracts, compute-matched CoVe and fixed-ledger RARR adaptations.
entries.falsification: Reject novelty or improvement if simple checks match it or answer/persona preservation worsens.
entries.independent_test: Independent complete-wrong, supported-partial, promise-only, quoted, negated and dated answers.
entries.observed_failure: Eight policy echoes can be factual Correct under the primary convention while all sixteen tasks fail.
entries.persona_cost: Editing may remove or flatten legitimate persona style.
entries.proposed_algorithm: Candidate claim/date/component-state contract with abstention; no new generation-based implementation justified yet.
entries.published_solution: Structured answer checks; CoVe factored verification; RARR evidence research and editing.
entries.remaining_gap: Whether a CPU-budgeted verifier improves delivered answers beyond simple component checks is untested.

entries.cpu_cost: Include temporal-query extraction, retrieval and reader calls, not just filtering.
entries.fair_comparison: Same top-one budget, extraction error counted, no oracle metadata for deployable methods.
entries.falsification: No method gap if established extraction/retrieval matches the candidate on independent cases.
entries.independent_test: Balanced current/historical questions, ambiguous dates, entity confusions and genuinely conflicting sources.
entries.observed_failure: Prior entity/time errors motivate checks; this H_none diagnostic does not demonstrate stale-history selection.
entries.persona_cost: Filtering current-only evidence can destroy useful historical information.
entries.proposed_algorithm: Keep privileged metadata filtering as an oracle baseline; prospectively test uncertain temporal attribution separately.
entries.published_solution: Time filtering, entity filtering, BM25 and LongMemEval time-aware expansion.
entries.remaining_gap: Existing supplied-time+BM25 already solves sixteen curated development pools; free-text date attribution remains untested.

entries.computational_distinction: None demonstrated; priority prompting must not be renamed FPPS.
entries.cpu_cost: FPPS requires detector training and activation access not provided by this completion diagnostic.
entries.fair_comparison: Equal cases/evidence, activation-compatible FPPS adaptation, history removal and style-preserving controls.
entries.falsification: Reject if removal/priority baselines match performance or personalization is lost.
entries.independent_test: Independent contradictions with separately measured factual reliability and persona fidelity.
entries.observed_failure: Past restricted package observations suggest a conflict question; new H_none outputs identify no unique persona-conflict mechanism.
entries.persona_cost: Must measure preserved useful personalization and style rather than reward deletion.
entries.proposed_algorithm: Typed evidence ownership is a hypothesis only until a surviving failure is isolated.
entries.published_solution: FPPS activation probing/steering, evidence-priority prompts and history removal.
entries.remaining_gap: No fair local FPPS comparison or reproducible residual failure beyond those baselines.

entries.computational_distinction: None established by recombining known filters.
entries.cpu_cost: Adjudication and selector calls must be included.
entries.fair_comparison: Budget-matched selection, identical admitted information where presentation varies, retained personalization.
entries.falsification: Reject if published or simple admission gives the same tradeoff.
entries.independent_test: Prospective relevant/irrelevant and valid/historical information with explicit requested dates.
entries.observed_failure: No memory-admission intervention is present in this H_none-only diagnostic.
entries.persona_cost: False exclusions erase valid preferences or historical persona facts.
entries.proposed_algorithm: Do not implement a new gate until a residual failure and exact rule distinction are specified.
entries.published_solution: FC/PS admission, PN/CH presentation and query-relevance selection.
entries.remaining_gap: CPU-efficient uncertain-source admission beyond these methods is not empirically established.

entries.fair_comparison: Predeclared fixed rule versus established fixed baselines under equal computation.
entries.falsification: No reproducible interaction or no benefit beyond fixed methods defeats the premise.
entries.independent_test: New independent cases and complete factorial coverage without using test outputs for rule tuning.
entries.observed_failure: P1c interactions were uncertain and boundary-sensitive; current design contains H_none only.
entries.persona_cost: Adaptive suppression could erase legitimate persona expression.
entries.proposed_algorithm: No adaptive algorithm until the interaction and failure are replicated.
entries.published_solution: Adaptive gating, steering and reranking are established families.
entries.remaining_gap: No stable localized interaction has been independently demonstrated.

negative_findings_preserved: No first-answer gain from larger budgets in the prior 144 requests.
No task-delivery gain from the current role-marker/stop diagnostic.
No demonstrated retrieval gap on the existing privileged-metadata development pool.
provenance: AI-assisted scientific synthesis; not independent human adjudication
